# Vamp

Vamp currently promotes two products:

- Vamp Assistant: native macOS AI companion with its own iOS app and browser
  Remote Sessions access: https://thevamp.app/assistant/
- Vamp Stream: focused iPhone/iPad visual client for Vamp Host, the supporting
  Vamp Stream Host, and Vamp Assistant: https://thevamp.app/stream/

Vamp Stream Host is the public name for the compatible `VampMiniHost`
implementation and release artifact. Other suite products remain in source and
specialist technical documentation but are not currently promoted.

Use only a trusted LAN or private Tailscale network. Verify every new device
before approval and never expose host ports publicly.

Suite source: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/vamp-suite
Assistant source: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/vamp-assistant
Install: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/vamp-suite/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md
Sideload: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/vamp-suite/blob/main/docs/IOS_SIDELOAD.md
Security: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/vamp-suite/blob/main/SECURITY.md
